General
Skin
HEENT 
Head 
Head: normal head contour, atraumatic, normocephalic, facial symmetry. no edema, erythema,
or masses. no tenderness of scalp, facial structures, joints, and temporal artery on palpation.
skull integrity intact. hair texture normal, full even distribution of hair, no masses, facial
drooping, fasciculations, thickening of skin, scaling/dryness, bony protuberance. B/L TMJ has
no tenderness on palpation, crepitus, or edema. B/L parotid gland is not tender on palpation,
firm, or enlarged. B/L sub-mandibular gland is not tender on palpation, firm, or enlarged.

Eyes 
Vital signs: 37.2 C (route unknown), P 71/min, RR 13/min, BP 111/72 mmHg (sitting, upper
Rt extremity, manual), SpO2 99% RA, Ht 177.8 cm, Wt 90.7 kg
General: NAD, A&O x3. well appeared. well groomed. well nourished. normal mood and
affect. appears stated age. No acute distress
Skin: warm, dry, intact, good turgor. no noted rashes or lesions. no abnormal bruising or
pigmentation. appropriate color. no edema noted. no significant scarring. no bromhidrosis.
Hair: normal texture and distribution. normal scalp integrity.
Nails: normal color. no deformities. no pitting, clubbing, or cyanosis.

Ears
Nose
Throat 
Neck 
External: BL eyebrow normal size, distribution, shape, extends to outer canthus. BL orbital
area has no edema, lesions, masses, redundant skin. BL eyelids are symmetric, have no
ptosis, edema, erythema, masses, lesions, scaling, infestations, or fasciculations. BL
lacrimal gland unremarkable. Conjunctiva and Sclera pink, no injections, discharge, edema,
pterygium, scleral icterus, or FB. Cornea clear. Iris intact. PERRLA, BL 3mm in size. No
photo-phobia. EOM intact, no nystagmus. Visual Acuity: Gross visual acuity intact. Using
the tumbling E chart, OD, OS, OU: 20/20, no corrective lens used. BL Visual fields are full
via confrontation. BL corneal reflex intact. Palpation: no tenderness, masses, lesions,
crepitus, edema noted on eyelids, globes, and orbital bones. Fundoscopic exam: BL red
reflex. Unremarkable disc-cup ratio. Disc well-defined and cream colored. No
haemorrhages, exudates, AV nicking. Macula intact and yellow-free.
External: BL auricle aligned with outer cathus. Auricle, tragus, mastoid, lobule have no
tenderness, erythema, edema, masses, or lesions. Internal: BL IAC has mild cerumen. BL
IAC has no erythema, edema, discharge, FB, lesions, or masses. BL TM is translucent,
pearly, intact, and convex. No effusion, retraction, scarring. BL TM is mobile with bony
landmarks and cone of light visualized. Tests: Conversational hearing intact. BL
unremarkable finger rub test. Weber lateralize BL. Rinne: AC>BC BL.
External: External inspection normal and symmetric. Skin appropriate color, no masses,
lesions, edema, ecchymoses, or rashes. No tenderness of bone, cartilage on palpation.
Frontal sinus', maxillary sinus', sphenoid sinus' non-tender when palpated and percussed.
Transillumination normal. BL nare patency intact. Internal: Muscosa pink, moist and septum
mid-line. No discharge, polyps, congestion, or FB.
External: Lips pink, intact, symmetric, well-defines. No edema, lesions, ecchymoses, or
crust. Mouth: Normal bite. Good dentition, no missing teeth, no tenderness on palpation.
Buccal mucosa pink and moist, no lesions. Gingiva pink and firm, no tenderness, lesions, or
sores. Tongue is pink and mid-line, no edema or lesions. Parotid glad, submandibular gland,
and sublingual glands are not tender, firm, or enlarged. Pharynx: Pharynx pink, moist, and
clear. Soft palate pink and symmetric. Uvula midline with symmetric rise. BL Tonsils +1
without exudates. Gag reflex intact.

Neck: no skin dryness, masses, discoloration, lesions, scars, or edema. no webbing, fullness in
the neck base, carotid prominence, jugular distension, overlying skin change or deformities.
SCM and trapezius is symmetric. B/L Anterior and posterior cervical triangles present and
unobstructed. No spinal deviation or tracheal deviation. No tenderness on palpation of cervical
spine and para vertebral muscles. Swallow symmetry. Range of motion intact. Thyroid:is
symmetric with normal consistency of the thyroid tissue and configuration. no tenderness on
palpation, enlargement, nodules, or edema. Symmetric coordinated swallow. negative thyroid
auscultation. Lymph Nodes: no overlying erythema, lymphangitic streaking, visual edema,
visual enlargement. Nodes are soft, freely mobile, and discrete with no enlargement, warmth,
and tenderness in the occipital, pre/post auricular, retro-pharyngeal, parotid, submandibular,
submental, anterior/posterior cervical, supraclavicular, infraclavicular, epitrochlear, inguinal,
femoral, popliteal lymph nodes. 
Lymph Nodes 
Lymph Nodes: no overlying erythema, lymphangitic streaking, visual edema, visual
enlargement. Nodes are soft, freely mobile, and discrete with no enlargement, warmth, and
tenderness in the occipital, pre/post auricular, retro-pharyngeal, parotid, submandibular,
submental, anterior/posterior cervical, supraclavicular, infraclavicular, epitrochlear, inguinal,
femoral, popliteal lymph nodes. 
Endocrine
Cardiac 
General: pt appears in NAD. (-) cyanosis, anxiety, diaphoresis, Levine Sign, labored breathing,
SOB.
Skin: (-) nail clubbing, splinter hemorrhages, Osler's Nodes, Janeway Lesions. Hair Distributed
normally.
Cardio: (-) Levine's Sign
no scars or chest wall deformities. PMI not visible, palpated at midclavicular line in 5th ICS. (-)
lifts, heaves, thrills on inspection or palpation. (-) tenderness on palpation. Auscultation: RRR,
S1 and S2 heard in all auscultation points, no rubs, clicks/gallops/snaps, murmur grade: 0. No
audible S3 or S4.
Vascular: Inspection: (-) carotid pulsations, varicose veins. Auscultation: (-) carotid bruit.
Palpation: peripheral edema grade: 0. JVP 3cm above sternal angle @ 30' elevation. (-) JVD
and hepatojugular reflex. capillary refill less than 3 sec. Carotid, radial, femoral, popliteal, PT,
DP pulses present (+2) and equal B/L. (-) distal changes in color or temp.
